## Limitations

The following limitations are known at this stage (to confirm by the team):

- **Risk Rating 2.0.** The NFIP rating system changed in 2021, inside the test window, so the insured portfolio may differ between training and test years.
- **Mandatory purchase.** Flood insurance is mandatory only in high-risk zones, so the insured portfolio is not representative of all properties, and the models describe claim frequency among insured policies only.
- **Rounded location.** Locations in the redacted data are rounded, so the assignment of records to tracts can be imprecise.
- **Missing tract.** The tract is missing for some records, which are lost for the tract-year analysis.
- **Event concentration.** Claims are concentrated in event years, and the test window contains Hurricane Ian (2022) and Hurricane Helene (2024). Test metrics may therefore depend on a few events.
- **Tract vintage.** Tract stability was checked nationally and still has to be reconfirmed on Region 4.
